# WOUB Public Media

> > WOUB is Ohio University's public broadcasting station delivering regional journalism, educational content, and community storytelling across southeast Ohio and Appalachia.

WOUB Public Media serves as the primary PBS and public radio affiliate for Ohio University and the broader southeast Ohio region. The organization combines investigative journalism, educational programming, and regional storytelling to serve communities in Athens, Portsmouth, and surrounding Appalachian areas.

## Core Services

- [About WOUB](https://woub.org/about-woub): Organization overview of WOUB Public Media, Ohio University's PBS and radio affiliate
- [Listen](https://woub.org/listen): Podcast and audio series hub featuring 150 Days, Next Witness, and more
- [WOUB Learning Lab](https://woub.org/woub-learning-lab): Educational media platform with PBS Kids content including Daniel Tiger and PHOEBE & JAY
- [Support WOUB](https://woub.org/support-woub): Membership and donation information for supporting WOUB Public Media

## Regional Storytelling & Features

- [Foothill Features](https://woub.org/foothillfeatures): Regional storytelling series featuring Appalachian narratives from Portsmouth and Athens, Ohio
- [Stories in WOUB's Housing Squeeze Series](https://www.woub.org/the-housing-squeeze): Investigative series on housing crisis and affordable housing in southeast Ohio

## News & Investigations

- [Pike County to be site of country's potentially largest data center](https://woub.org/2026/03/20/federal-government-pike-county-site-courntrys-largest-data-center-federal-trade-deal): News coverage of SoftBank's AI data center development in Pike County, Ohio
- [Proposed constitutional amendment bans huge AI data centers in Ohio](https://woub.org/2026/03/19/group-proposing-constitutional-amendment-ban-huge-ai-data-centers-ohio): News on rural Ohio groups proposing constitutional amendment against large AI data centers
- [Effort to repeal ban on intoxicating hemp, THC drinks will not make Ohio ballot](https://woub.org/2026/03/19/effort-repeal-ban-intoxicating-hemp-thc-drinks-will-not-make-ohio-ballot): News coverage of failed referendum to repeal Ohio's intoxicating hemp and THC beverage ban
